QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Romeo's Love Letter
QuestInfo.1: After finally completing the letter, Romeo asked me if I could deliver the letter to #bJuliet#k for him. What am I, their loyal servant???
QuestInfo.2: After receiving Romeo's heartfelt letter, Juliet shed a tear of joy. I don't understand how that letter brought her to tears, but...

0.0: Look, traveler! The letter is finally finished! I don't even know how many sheets of paper I went through writing this. Anyway, I bet Juliet will be ecstatic once she reads this letter. Now, please give this letter to #bJuliet#k for me.

yes.0: The reason Juliet and I are going well right now is because of you. I will never, ever forget all the good deeds you're doing for us!

no.0: I didn't expect you to say no... then who will give this letter to her? An owl? Package delivery? No, you're the only person that can help me. Please help me!

1.0: Hello, traveler. What is it this time? Is it... Romeo again...? What? Romeo wanted you to deliver that letter to me?

yes.0: Ahh, I can't believe Romeo thought of me like that... this is quite a surprise. I am... beyond happy. I don't know how to react to this, other than being really happy. Thank you so much, traveler...

npc.0: Haven't you gone to see Juliet yet? I am anxious to find out how she'll react to the letter.

item.0: Oh, hello traveler! What brought you back here? Is it... Romeo? Or not?

lost.0: What? You lost the letter I was supposed to give to Juliet? Ah, don't worry too much about it. It took me such a long time to write it, that I memorized every line word by word. I'll write you another one.
